sources.label: Michii
sources.author: Michii
patch_list: Block tracking
Adds an option (off by default) to stop sending most LinkedIn analytics events.
Bottom bar style
Adds switches in Michii Patches to hide bottom bar tabs, their labels and their notification badges, and optionally Material icons in the bottom bar (filled when selected, outlined otherwise).
Copy post text
Long pressing a post's text copies all of it, including the part behind "...more".
Disable double-tap like
Stops double tapping a post or photo from liking it.
Download media
Adds a download button to the full screen photo and video viewer.
Feed filters

Adds optional filters (off by default, turned on in Michii Patches): focus mode, celebrations, job cards, reposts, posts from others' activity, "Recommended for you", video posts, games, the "New posts" pill and "See translation".
GmsCore support
Makes "Continue with Google" work in patched LinkedIn by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Hide ads
Removes promoted (sponsored) posts from the feed.
Hide Premium upsells
Removes Premium and AI upsell cards and banners, including on profiles and the Me panel.
Hide promoted jobs
Removes promoted job listings from the Jobs tab and job search.
Hide suggested posts
Removes "Suggested" posts from outside your network from the feed.
Icon-only post actions
Adds a switch in Michii Patches to show the Like, Comment, Repost and Send buttons under posts without their labels.
Material You

Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+): the accent color instead of LinkedIn blue and the green of selected filters, and Material 3 surface colors for backgrounds, cards, bars and borders. Some screens drawn by LinkedIn's servers may k…
Messaging
Hides sponsored messages, and adds an optional ghost mode that does not send typing indicators or read status.
Open links directly
Opens external links without LinkedIn's safety/go warning page.
Remove gaps and dividers
Removes the gray gaps between posts and the dividers between list items, so the feed and lists are one flat surface.
Sanitize share links
Removes tracking parameters from LinkedIn links when they are copied or shared.

sources.label: Loki Patches: LinkedIn without ads and clutter, and copy any text. Patches for M
sources.author: Loki
patch_list: AMOLED black bars
Turns the dark top bar, bottom bar, side menu and the other screens the app draws pure black, matching the feed that the AMOLED black setting already covers. Needs Material You.
Anonymous profile viewing
Adds an option (off by default, experimental) to visit profiles without being listed in "Who viewed your profile": the analytics events of profile pages are not sent.
Block tracking
Adds a switch (off by default) that stops most of LinkedIn's analytics events from being sent.
Copy text
Long press a post, comment or any other text to select and copy it in place, like on Reddit.
Dark app icon
Black launcher icon with the white "in", instead of LinkedIn's blue. Chosen when patching: a launcher icon cannot switch with dark mode on its own.
Disable double-tap like
A double tap on a post or a photo no longer likes it.
Download media
Puts a download button in the full screen photo, video and document viewer; documents (PDFs and carousels) are saved as a single PDF.
Feed filters

Adds a set of filters that are off until turned on in Loki Patches: focus mode, celebrations, job cards, reposts, posts from other people's activity, "Recommended for you", video posts, games, the "New posts" pill and "See translation".
GmsCore support
Routes "Continue with Google" through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services, so signing in works in patched LinkedIn. microG RE has to be installed and signed in to a Google account.
Hide ads
Removes sponsored (promoted) posts from the feed.
Hide bottom tabs
Adds switches to take My Network and Jobs out of the bottom bar.
Hide Premium upsells
Drops the Premium and AI upsell cards and banners, on profiles and in the Me panel too.
Hide promoted jobs
Drops promoted job listings from the Jobs tab and from job searches.
Hide suggested posts
Drops the "Suggested" posts from people outside your network.
Keep feed on reopen
Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to LinkedIn, instead of reloading it. Pull down or tap the "New posts" button to load new posts.
Material You

Takes the colors from your wallpaper (Android 12+): the accent replaces LinkedIn blue and the green of the selected filters, and the backgrounds, cards, bars and borders become Material 3 surfaces. Some screens LinkedIn draws from its serv…
Messaging
Drops sponsored messages from the inbox, and adds an optional ghost mode that sends no typing indicators and no read receipts.
Open links directly
Skips LinkedIn's safety/go warning page and opens external links straight away.
Post menu items
Adds Copy text, Download photos and videos, and Save document as PDF to the ⋯ menu of posts.
Remove gaps and dividers
Removes the gray gaps between posts and the dividers between list items, so the feed and the lists read as one flat surface.
Sanitize share links
Strips the tracking parameters from LinkedIn links that get copied or shared.
Swipe between feeds
Swipe left and right on the home feed to switch between For you and Network, like on X.
Tap to hide in viewers
Tap a video or document in full screen to hide the caption and buttons, like photos.

sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Always show navigation bar
Adds an option in Fakh Patches to keep the navigation bar on screen while you scroll.
Anonymous profile viewing
Adds an option (off by default) to visit profiles without being listed in "Who viewed your profile": the app does not report the visit.
Copy text
Press and hold a post, comment or any other text to open it in a sheet where it can be selected and copied.
Disable analytics
Adds an option (off by default) to stop sending most LinkedIn analytics events.
Disable double-tap like
Stops double tapping a post or photo from liking it.
Download media
Adds a download button to the full screen photo and video viewer.
Expand posts
Adds an option in Fakh Patches (off by default) to show posts expanded by default. Tapping the text collapses them.
Feed filters

Adds optional filters in Fakh Patches (off by default): engagement counts, celebrations, job cards, network activity (likes, comments, reposts), video posts, "Recommended for you", puzzle games, the "New posts" pill and "Show translation".
Glass navigation bar
Draws the navigation bar as a floating, translucent capsule with a sliding selection pill. Slide a finger along it to switch tabs. Liquid Glass blurs what's behind it.
GmsCore support
Makes "Continue with Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Hide ads
Removes promoted (sponsored) posts from the feed.
Hide gaps and dividers
Removes the gray gaps between posts and the dividers between list items, so the feed and lists are one flat surface.
Hide Premium upsells
Removes Premium and AI upsell cards and banners, including on profiles and the profile menu.
Hide promoted jobs
Removes promoted job listings from the Jobs tab and job search.
Hide suggested posts
Removes "Suggested" posts from outside your network from the feed.
Material You

Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+): the accent color instead of LinkedIn blue and the green of selected filters, and Material 3 surface colors for backgrounds, cards, bars and borders. Some screens drawn by LinkedIn's servers may k…
Messaging
Hides sponsored messages, and adds an optional ghost mode that does not send typing indicators or read status.
More tab
Lets you hide items of the More tab (Puzzle games, Groups, Events, Newsletters), or list them at the bottom of the profile menu.
Navigation bar
Adds options in Fakh Patches to hide the More, Jobs, Network and Notifications tabs of the navigation bar, its count badges and its labels.
Open links directly
Opens external links without LinkedIn's safety/go warning page.
Pitch black
Replaces the gray backgrounds of dark mode with black, and cards with a slightly lighter black. Takes effect when the system is in dark mode. Works with or without Material You.
Sanitize share links
Removes tracking parameters from LinkedIn links when they are copied or shared.
Swipe between tabs
Swipe sideways to go to the next or previous tab of the navigation bar.
